sentences.l1: Many people like to buy new clothes.
Making textiles requires a lot of water.

sentences.l2: 水用多了，有些地方的人就没有干净水喝。
sentences.l1: When a lot of water is used, people in some places have no clean water to drink.

sentences.l2: 工厂做衣服时，也让水变脏。
sentences.l1: When factories make clothes, they also make the water dirty.

sentences.l2: 脏水流到河里，鱼也会死。
sentences.l1: When dirty water flows into rivers, fish will also die.

sentences.l2: 商店一直卖新衣服，人们就一直买。
sentences.l1: Shops keep selling new clothes, so people keep buying.

sentences.l2: 从工厂到商店是一条路，叫供应链。
sentences.l1: The road from the factory to the shop is a road called the supply chain.

sentences.l2: 我们少买点衣服，就能省水，也能帮地球。
sentences.l1: If we buy a little fewer clothes, we can save water and can also help the Earth.
